title: A playful, compact tools wiki
question: Choose the next direction. Both use JetBrains Mono and preserve Starlight.

options.label: Keycap Index
options.lineage: Mechanical keyboard legends and modular key layouts
options.thesis: A compact tool grid with mint, peach, and lilac accents.
options.viewport: Short search-first header, small title, dense tool tiles; docs use compact headings and quiet content surfaces.
options.risk: More modular and playful; repeated tiles can feel busy.

raised.raise: Use color to distinguish navigation from quiet reading.
Maintain a complete readable mobile view.
Make repeated entries consistent and scannable.
Give selection a shape cue alongside color.
Keep row rhythm compact and consistent.

options.label: Syntax Studio
options.thesis: Violet, teal, and coral give a compact reference index personality.
options.viewport: Compact search bar and title above tool rows; docs use mono headings, restrained colored markers, and tight code frames.
options.risk: A familiar developer aesthetic; differentiation comes from color and spacing.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.risk: Architectural sections are less familiar to developer lookup and spatial annotations slow scanning.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Architectural sections are less familiar to developer lookup and spatial annotations slow scanning.
options.kept: Use color to distinguish navigation from quiet reading.

options.label: Folded Sheet
options.thesis: Tool groups unfold from a compact packet.
options.viewport: Tool groups unfold from a compact packet.
options.risk: Fold geometry has weaker developer identification and conceals useful commands.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Fold geometry has weaker developer identification and conceals useful commands.
options.kept: Maintain a complete readable mobile view.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Tool entries indexed by colored catalog marks.
options.viewport: Tool entries indexed by colored catalog marks.
options.risk: Coded identity is less developer-specific and slows recognition of tool names.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Coded identity is less developer-specific and slows recognition of tool names.
options.kept: Make repeated entries consistent and scannable.

options.label: Terminal Signs
options.thesis: Tool destinations presented in directional bands.
options.viewport: Tool destinations presented in directional bands.
options.risk: Airport signage has weaker developer identification and oversized bands reduce reference density.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Airport signage has weaker developer identification and oversized bands reduce reference density.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: Tool sections attach to a thin colored rail.
options.viewport: Tool sections attach to a thin colored rail.
options.risk: Spectral marks are less recognizable than tool labels and understate navigation.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Spectral marks are less recognizable than tool labels and understate navigation.
options.kept: Give selection a shape cue alongside color.

options.label: Destination Roll
options.thesis: Tools occupy compact stacked destination bands.
options.viewport: Tools occupy compact stacked destination bands.
options.risk: Transport machinery is less developer-specific and clipped stepping impairs reading.
options.case: Declined on developer identification and lookup clarity. Transport machinery is less developer-specific and clipped stepping impairs reading.
options.kept: Keep row rhythm compact and consistent.

canonCard.label: Clean docs, playful accents
canonCard.thesis: Conventional documentation with a brighter accent palette.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar Starlight layout with tighter spacing and colorful active states.
canonCard.risk: Closest to the existing layout; a smaller change in character.
